messages:
Maya: Quick sync — ACME flagged two asks that pressure our Q2 roadmap: feature parity for per-tenant routing controls, and a simplified fallback policy for low-tier tenants. They want dates. Can we triage?
Liam: Thanks — parity is doable but non-trivial. It touches routing rules + Console UI + RBAC. Ballpark 6 weeks for MVP if we cut scope.
Arjun: Technical constraint: the routing storage schema currently assumes org-wide rules. Making it per-tenant requires a migration path and config model work. Estimate ~3w infra + 2w runtime + 1w QA.
Priya: From product POV, we should ask whether ACME absolutely needs exact parity or just an equivalent UX. Could we satisfy them with a "compatible mode" that maps tenant rules to org rules via a shim? :thinking_face:
Zoe: A shim could buy time but will increase complexity and tech debt. If we go shim-first, we should include a sunset plan in the launch notes.
Kevin (sales): ACME is pushing hard — they said procurement will stall without per-tenant controls. They can be flexible on date (+2 weeks) if we promise a clear GA roadmap.
Maya: Proposal: ship a gated MVP that meets customer gating criteria and uses a shim to emulate per-tenant behavior, then follow with full parity in a later sprint. Need consensus on launch criteria.
Arjun: If we do shim-MVP, we must lock defaults to avoid surprising behavior. Also add feature flagging to enable quick rollback.
Priya: Draft launch criteria suggestion:
```
1) Shim enabled with documented limitations
2) UI exposes "tenant routing" in limited mode (create/edit only, no import/export)
3) E2E tests for critical fallthrough and canary rollout to Dedicated
4) Rollback flag + migration dry-run plan
5) Sales-facing doc with supported limitations
```
Maya: +1 to those. Add SLOs for latency bump on routing path (<= 20% increase) and must pass ACME's sample traffic test.
Liam: Implementation notes: I'll scope a minimal Console flow (list/create/edit) and wire the flag. Need Arjun & EngSRE for rollout plan.
Arjun: EngSRE: we need a gradual rollout: 5% orgs -> 25% -> 100%, with artifact-based rollback. deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2187657200 if approvals done.
Zoe: We should also capture the alternative: if we decide full parity now, timeline becomes 10-12 weeks but with cleaner architecture. Include tradeoff doc.
Kevin (sales): Please give me a customer-facing ETA by EOD so I can stall procurement intelligently.
Maya: Action items:
- Liam: deliver scoped console PR and effort estimate by EOD (Liam)
- Arjun: migration/rollout plan and risk list (2 days)
- Zoe: draft debt/sunset language for shim (tomorrow)
- Priya: update launch checklist with SLOs and ACME test plan (tomorrow noon)
- Kevin: hold cadence with ACME and give our preferred date next week
Maya: If nobody objects, I'll move the shim-MVP into the live roadmap and mark full parity as a follow-up epic. :thumbsup:
Liam: No objections from eng side here.
Arjun: Agree with approach, noting we must track the tech debt item in backlog.
Priya: Fine from product. We'll call it "compatibility-mode v1" in external comms.
Kevin (sales): Sounds good — I'll push ACME toward the compatibility-mode timeline.
Zoe: Add a follow-up meeting to revisit the architecture decision after the canary results.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll update the roadmap entry and send a short doc to the #exec-sync channel once we have the rollout plan.
